name: Imhotep
subtitle: Architect of Ascension
description: Ascend your allies reducing their Divinity Requirements and Restoring their Health
lore: Advisor to pharaohs, Imhotep held great authority and respect in his prior life. Since the Shattering, he has discovered that his reputation had grown in his absence, until many revere him as a god. While he labors on Aaru’s behalf, he finds himself uncertain what is expected of him, or how to wield this new influence that has been thrust upon him.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Pillar of Support
Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Bane of Sorcery

skills.name: Pillar of Support

skills.name: Steps of Ascension
skills.description: Place [mechanic:radiance-ii] on all allies for 1 turn then reduce each target's Divinity Cost by 3% (stacking up to 3times).

skills.name: Grand Architect
skills.description: At the start of each wave, place [mechanic:ward] on the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns.
